label: Dragon
description: Dragons as material studies — every build names its scale substance and how light behaves on it. Environment-neutral, so any scene can host one.

items.name: obsidian-wyrm
items.text: an obsidian-black wyrm, scales like knapped volcanic glass, light sliding along the fracture edges in thin oily rainbows, wing membranes swallowing light whole

items.name: brass-dragon
items.text: a brass-scaled dragon, plates gone tea-dark with patina except along the flex lines where motion keeps them mirror-bright, eyes like drops of molten metal

items.name: nacre-dragon
items.text: a nacre-scaled dragon, every plate holding the soft rainbow of mother-of-pearl, its whole flank changing color with each small shift of the light

items.name: ember-seamed
items.text: a charcoal-hided dragon with molten seams glowing between its plates, heat-shimmer rising off its back, every breath brightening the light between the scales

items.name: frost-wyrm
items.text: a frost-white wyrm furred with hoarfrost along its spine, breath rolling out as freezing fog, ice glazed thickest at the shoulders where it rarely moves

items.name: verdigris-drake
items.text: a bronze-green drake weathered like a harbor statue, verdigris streaking down from every scale edge, rain-polished highlights on the brow and knuckles

items.name: blind-white-wyrm
items.text: a blind bone-white cave wyrm, eyeless skull smooth as porcelain, reading the air with a constantly moving forked tongue, veins faint through translucent wing-skin

items.name: gilded-wyrm
items.text: a gold-scaled dragon nearly invisible against treasure, coin-round scales lapped in strict rows, only the slow rise of its breathing telling hoard from hide

items.name: storm-drake
items.text: a slate-grey storm drake, static crawling in blue threads along its wing edges, claw-tips sparking wherever they touch stone

items.name: moss-elder
items.text: an elder dragon grown over with moss and hanging ferns, so old and so still it reads as a mossy rise of ground until the eye finds the slow-breathing ribs
